evidence.label: def:p15-general-conditional-expectation: G-measurable real version with defined event integrals equal to those of X on every A in G; a.e. identification of versions; P(B|G)=E(1_B|G); E(X|Y)=E(X|sigma(Y)); C_G notation (matches Durrett p. 205-206 (i),(ii), p. 208 P(A|G), E(X|Y))
thm:p15-conditional-existence delivers the integrability promised at line 28
every version integrable (A={Z>0}) and a.e. unique: the identification of versions is worked
worked boundary of the version concept: value at the null observation Y=0 is not determined
null-observation version freedom proved from the defining identity
thm:p15-conditional-existence statement incl. E|C_G X|<=E|X|, a.e. uniqueness, source RN construction on X^+ and X^-, no completeness of G

annex:p15.conditional-existence: integrability via A={Z>0} (Durrett Lemma 4.1.1), uniqueness via A_n={Z>=Z'+1/n}, existence by RN for nu_+ and nu_- on (Omega,G), infinite-value sets reset on a G-null set, no completion used
thm:p15-conditional-basic: linearity, E(C_G X)=EX, order, |C_G X|<=C_G|X|, known information, independence (sigma(X) vs G), locality on B in G, 0<=P(A|G)<=1
annex:p15.conditional-basic: each claim tested on conditioning events; locality via A_n=B cap {C_G X>=C_G Y+1/n}; source Theorem 4.1.2, 4.1.9(a)(b), Examples 4.1.3-4.1.4, (4.1.5) preserved

thm:p15-conditional-limits: nonnegative extension, uniqueness, truncation construction, compatibility, monotone convergence, Fatou, dominated convergence, single null set, F_0-null modification boundary
pointer to the null-modification witness and to the source's decreasing variant (Durrett p. 210 remark, checked in held source)

annex:p15.conditional-limits: truncation with G-null reset, uniqueness via A_mn, order for the extension, conditional MCT, Fatou via Y_n=inf_{k>=n}X_k, DCT via Fatou on Y+X_n and Y-X_n, L1 convergence
thm:p15-w02b-p15-008-null-modification: G-measurability criterion and witness on [0,1] with trivial G (worked boundary of the last sentence)
proof of the null-modification theorem, parts (i)-(iii)
thm:p15-w02b-p15-008-decreasing: source decreasing variant with E|Y_1|,E|Y|<infinity and witness that E|Y_1|<infinity cannot be dropped
proof of the decreasing theorem via Y_1-Y_n and item 1, plus the infinite-mean witness
thm:p15-conditional-jensen: hypotheses E|X|,E|phi(X)|<infinity; rational-minorant supremum for nonaffine phi; separate affine case and irrational-slope boundary

annex:p15.conditional-jensen: two supporting slopes for nonaffine phi, rational approximation within epsilon, affine case by linearity, irrational-slope boundary worked, countable exceptional union (Durrett Theorem 4.1.10 and its remark preserved)
prerequisite: supporting affine function at every real point (cited by line 179 of the conditional annex)
def:p15-lp-conditional-spaces: a.e. equivalence classes, ||.||_p for p<infinity, essential-sup ||.||_infinity, L^infinity(G), F_0 analogue, L^2 inner product
boundary worked: the essential-sup infimum is itself an a.e. bound
inner product finite by Cauchy-Schwarz and definite on classes
thm:p15-conditional-lp: norms on classes, maps L^p(F_0) to L^p(G) for 1<=p<=infinity, contraction and difference inequalities, preservation of L^p convergence
annex:p15.conditional-lp: norm axioms, Minkowski via Hoelder for p>1, L^infinity case, contraction by conditional Jensen and E(C_G|X|^p)=E|X|^p (Durrett Theorem 4.1.11 route), p=infinity by order
thm:p15-conditional-tower: both tower identities for G subset H subset F_0, measurable-version reduction (Durrett 4.1.12), nesting essential
annex:p15.conditional-tower: both identities and the reduction checked on conditioning events (Durrett 4.1.13 (i),(ii))
worked boundary: non-nested G_1,G_2 on {a,b,c} with unequal iterated conditionings (Durrett Exercise 4.1.5)
table of X, C_{G1}X, C_{G2}X and both iterated columns; noncommutation without nesting proved
thm:p15-conditional-pullout: hypotheses E|X|,E|ZX|<infinity only; integrability of right side; nonnegative extended form with 0*infinity=0
annex:p15.conditional-pullout: indicator, simple, monotone limit (Durrett 4.1.14 four-step route), signed case via four products, right-side integrability without E|Z|<infinity
thm:p15-conditional-partitions: cell averages on positive cells, null-cell convention, trivial G gives EX, finite formula recovered (Durrett Example 4.1.5 extended to null cells)
annex:p15.conditional-partitions: G is unions of cells, measurability, E|Z|<=E|X|, identity on every union, null cells, trivial and finite partitions
def:p15-finite-conditional-expectation with zero on null fibres, the formula said to be recovered
thm:p15-conditional-factorization: real and nonnegative extended sigma(Y)-measurable Z=h(Y), E(X|Y)=h(Y), uniqueness only mu_Y-a.e., no image measurability
annex:p15.conditional-factorization: preimage sigma-algebra, disjointified simple lifts, limsup of lifts, signed case on the finite set, mu_Y-a.e. uniqueness

thm:p15-conditional-density-formulas: joint-density formula on D with zero elsewhere and P(Y in D)=1; independent-coordinate formula with zero on non-integrable sections (Durrett Examples 4.1.6 with its remark, and 4.1.7)
annex:p15.conditional-density-formulas: Tonelli marginals, null exceptional sets, integrability of h(Y), Fubini event identity; product law, Fubini sections, event identity for sigma(X)
thm:p15-conditional-l2-space: L^2(F_0) Hilbert, L^2(G) closed subspace, no completeness of the sigma-algebra (Durrett remark after 4.1.15)
annex:p15.conditional-l2-space: inner product, fast Cauchy subsequence, measurable limit off a measurable null set, full-sequence convergence, closedness of the G-subspace
thm:p15-conditional-l2-projection: orthogonality, Pythagorean prediction-error identity, a.e.-unique minimizer over all G-measurable real competitors (Durrett Theorem 4.1.15)
annex:p15.conditional-l2-projection: pull-out gives E[Z(X-M)]=0, expansion with zero cross term, uniqueness, finite-error competitors are square integrable
def:p15-conditional-variance: Var(X|G)=C_G(X^2)-(C_G X)^2 for square-integrable X (Durrett Exercise 4.1.7 definition)
promised identification with the conditional squared residual and nonnegativity delivered
worked case: trivial G, X=+-1 gives C_G(X^2)=1, (C_G X)^2=0
worked case: Var(S|N)=sigma^2 N for a random sum

thm:p15-conditional-variance: residual form and nonnegativity, total-variance law, nested identity for G subset H, monotonicity of mean-square error under enlarged information (Durrett Exercises 4.1.6 and 4.1.7)

annex:p15.conditional-variance: residual expansion by linearity and pull-out, nonnegativity by order, expectation and Var(M) give total variance, H-projection identity with competitor C_G X, dropping the nonnegative term
the H-projection identity invoked by the nested step (proved for an arbitrary sub-sigma-algebra)
thm:p15-conditional-inequalities: conditional Chebyshev, conditional Cauchy-Schwarz, general Bayes identity with P(A)>0, partition Bayes formula (Durrett Exercises 4.1.1-4.1.3)
annex:p15.conditional-inequalities: indicator bound with order; rational quadratic, single null set, D>0 and D=0 cases; Bayes ratio and cellwise substitution with null cells
thm:p15-conditional-random-sums: ES=mu EN, Var(S)=sigma^2 EN+mu^2 Var(N), N>=0 with empty sum, source positive-integer case (Durrett Exercise 4.1.8)
annex:p15.conditional-random-sums: ES^2<=EN^2 EY_1^2 first, cellwise conditional moments, partition formula, Var(S|N)=sigma^2 N, total variance, n=0 case
thm:p15-conditional-same-law: integrable same-law case and square-integrable second-moment case (Durrett Exercises 4.1.9 and 4.1.10 with its shifted-sign hint)
annex:p15.conditional-same-law: conditional Jensen for |X-c|, sign agreement on {M>c},{M<c},{M=c}, equal-probability threshold events, rational thresholds; orthogonality for the L^2 case
thm:p15-conditional-examples: noncommuting three-point model, nonmultiplicativity under trivial G, freely assignable value at the null observation Y=0
annex:p15.conditional-examples: full table with event identities, symmetric two-point computation, explicit defining identity and version change on {Y=0}

defect_observations.observation: Stale anchors. The unit records body sha256 5885f5bb... (369 lines) and annex sha256 3fddcca4... (736 lines); the current files are cb5c3355... (382 lines) and b0785ebd... (741 lines). body_lines for C005-C021 are offset by +11 (C021 by +13), declared_proof_destinations for C005-C020 by +5, and C020's exact_current_text no longer matches body lines 365-371. The packet work/waves/w02b/packets/w02b-p15-007.json reader_evidence hashes and line_end values are stale in the same way. Evidence here cites current lines.

C008 asserts that non-nested conditioning sigma-algebras need not commute, but neither the statement nor its declared proof annex:p15.conditional-tower (annex lines 279-297) points to the witness. The witness exists only at thm:p15-conditional-examples item 1 (body 355-361, annex 703-720). Coverage is met; a cross-reference is missing.
C016 proof states that XM and M^2 are integrable without citing the reason (contraction M in L^2 plus Cauchy-Schwarz). That justification appears only in the preceding C014 proof (annex 522-524).

C007 proof justifies convexity of |t|^p and the bound |X+Y|^p<=2^{p-1}(|X|^p+|Y|^p) in one compressed sentence ('integrating that monotonicity gives the secant inequalities'). The auxiliary step is sound, but no derivation is written out.

C004 dominated-convergence proof gets the upper bound with 'Applying Fatou to Y-X_n likewise gives ...'. The operation is named and the result stated, but the mirrored display is omitted. Judged a written step, not a 'similarly' substitution, because the inputs and conclusion are explicit and the finiteness needed for cancellation is stated at lines 155-157.

C010's claim that the finite formula of def:p15-finite-conditional-expectation is recovered (body 209-210) is discharged by one clause. The matching to the finite space (Omega finite, events 2^Omega, sum-based E[X|B], zero on null fibres) is direct but not spelled out.
